questions.passage: So, why should multicultural experiences be associated with creativity? Leung and colleagues speculate that people acquire novel ideas and concepts from multicultural experiences. One new concept I learned about when I moved to the U.S. was the possibility of building or renovating your own house. For an American reader, this is an ordinary idea.
questions.prompt: What mechanism do Leung and colleagues speculate about here?
options: Exposure prevents people from learning any new concepts.
Multicultural experience introduces novel ideas and concepts.
Every American builds a house personally.
All creativity arises from house renovation alone.
questions.promptZh: Leung 及同事在此推测什么机制？
optionsZh: 接触阻止学习新概念。
多文化经历带来新想法和概念。
每个美国人亲手造房。
所有创造力只来自装修。
analyses: A acquire novel 与阻止相反。
B speculate 明确机制推测；建房是作者个人例子。
C ordinary idea 不等于人人实际亲自做。
D 一个例子不能限缩为唯一来源。

evidence.quote: people acquire novel ideas and concepts from multicultural experiences.

vocabulary.context: 机制尚以推测表达，不改成该段独立实验证明
vocabulary.example: The researchers speculate that new concepts support flexibility.

questions.translation: 为何多文化经历应与创造力关联？Leung 及同事推测，人从中获得新想法和概念。我到美国后新学的概念之一，是自己建造或翻新房子的可能性。对美国读者，这是普通想法。

questions.passage: American balloon framing is a genius invention that makes constructing houses easier. These concepts were totally out-of-box thinking to me, but now seem quite normal. I bet my college friends in Tokyo would think I was crazy if I decided to build my own house.
questions.prompt: What is the status of the claim about the author's college friends in Tokyo?
questions.promptZh: 关于东京大学朋友的说法属于哪种状态？
options: It records their actual responses after visiting his completed house.
It is his conjecture about how they would react if he decided to build his own house.
It reports that every friend has already built an identical house.
It is a direct quotation from a survey completed by those friends.

是作者对自己若决定造房时，他们会如何反应的猜想。
报告每个朋友都已造同款房。
是这些朋友填写的调查中的直接引语。
analyses: A if I decided 仍为假设，非完成建房后的反馈。
B I bet 与 would...if 显示作者预计反应，并非朋友实际报告。
C 句中无朋友造房事实。
D 无调查或朋友引语，不能把叙述者猜测转作实测证据。

questions.passage: Leung and colleagues also speculate that multicultural experiences teach us to recognize that the same behavior can have different meanings. A smile is a good example. I was raised not to smile in front of people because it could come across as impolite. But when I came to the U.S., everyone told me to smile more because it would be more polite!
questions.prompt: What does the smile example illustrate?
options: Smiling has exactly the same meaning everywhere.
Multicultural experience erases all cultural interpretation.
The same behavior can carry different meanings in different settings.
The author was never told to change his behavior.
optionsZh: 到处含义完全相同。
多文化经历消除全部文化解释。
同一行为在不同环境可有不同含义。
作者从未被要求改行为。
analyses: A same behavior...different meanings 正相反。
B 是认识多种意义，非消除解释。
C 作者成长中与到美国后的礼貌反馈对照。
D 被告知 smile more。这是个人文化经历与研究者推测，不把日本所有情境都简化成禁止微笑。

evidence.quote: the same behavior can have different meanings.

vocabulary.context: 微笑在作者成长规范下可能被认为不礼貌

questions.translation: Leung 及同事还推测，多文化经历教我们认识，同一行为会有不同意义。微笑是好例子。我从小受教在人前别微笑，因为可能显得不礼貌。但到美国，人人叫我多笑，说这样更礼貌！
questions.editorialStatus: 完整PDF118–122原页视觉核对和跨页拼接。列车118接触/97回收/另105想象者分开，随机分组结果是自报愉快不作长期普适保证。Jobs自我归因与作者传记叙述非实验；海外生活MBA比较不擅加随机性；多文化机制保留speculate/seem、综述不冒充全部因果。DIY及微笑为作者个人文化经验，不推广为全体日本人规范；道德相对主义和作弊保留correlated，不诊断个体。Jobs艺术引语不当实证，奖励保留might。第11章逆境先设问，Nietzsche地震是哲学隐喻并承认破坏，非受害者必然成长或医学处方。不宣称逐句直接证据全覆盖。
